Kane vows to be back for ‘business end of season’ after ankle surgery
uutiset.s: Harry Kane is targeting the "business end of the season" after undergoing surgery on a torn ligament in his left ankle.

uutiset.t: Australia complete record T20I chase at MCG to edge England in thriller
uutiset.s: Australia pulled off a record T20I run chase of 188 at the MCG to beat England by three wickets with a ball to spare in a thrilling series opener in Melbourne on Saturday.

uutiset.t: 'George had perfect position' - Wolff defends Mercedes' Vegas Q3 strategy
uutiset.s: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff dismissed suggestions the team should have done more to aid George Russell's bid for Las Vegas Grand Prix pole as he insisted the British driver had "perfect" track position for his final run in qualifying.

uutiset.t: 'Somebody’s got to stand up to that guy' - Russell slams Verstappen after clash
uutiset.s: George Russell launched a scathing criticism of Max Verstappen after a clash between them in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix ahead of a race they will now start on the front row together.
